title: Streaming in React the Simple Way: Server-Sent Events (with FastAPI)
description:
Tired of blank spinners? In this video, we add LLM-style streaming to a React app using Server-Sent Events (SSE) and a FastAPI backend—no WebSockets, no drama.

What you’ll learn

When to choose SSE vs WebSockets (uni-directional vs bi-directional)

How to build a FastAPI SSE endpoint with sse-starlette

Using EventSource in React (state, cleanup, error handling)

Practical tips: retries, proxies, CORS, and “end” events

Blog Post: https://shivam-sahil.vercel.app/portfolio-blogs/ai/3I44s8qb1iDcR2FBhvYiTE
